name: Glitch Scroll Gallery
description: Vertical image gallery rendered in WebGL where images glitch and smear horizontally in proportion to scroll speed, laid out as alternating single images and rows of three.
contents: Alternating solo image and three-image row blocks with colored borders
Fixed full-viewport WebGL canvas drawing the images over a solid background
behavior: Images are drawn as textures on a canvas synced to their DOM positions on every frame
Scroll velocity drives a glitch strength that decays over time
Meshes outside the viewport are hidden
editableByProps: Image list, background and border colors, border width and radius
Aspect ratio, spacing, and block widths
Glitch intensity, sample count, decay and render resolution

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the solo and row pattern

fixed: Canvas is fixed to the viewport and covers the whole screen behind the images
Image positions are read from the page scroll of the window, so the component expects to scroll with the page
Background color is applied both to the root and the WebGL clear color
